name: Kirisaka Sora
source:
The eldest child of the Kirisaka family.

Kagokita High School 3rd year. She takes care of her two younger siblings while doing all the housework on behalf of their parents, who often leave home for work. She tries her best to be a good sister.

She is the vice-president of the light music club at school and is in charge of vocals.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/hitoyane/]official website[/url]]
